description: Exercise substitution from a personal trainer's exercise library (MTFIT): get 1 to 3 alternatives for one exercise because of no equipment (gym, home dumbbells, bands or bodyweight), pain (shoulder, lower back), too hard, or variety. Each with a coaching cue. Text plus structured JSON. Not medical advice.

equipment.description: Equipment available now. Defaults to the exercise's own setting.

exercise.description: The exercise to replace, e.g. 'Barbell deadlift' or 'Cable fly'.

muscle.description: The muscle it trains. Needed only if the exercise is not in the MTFIT library.

pain_area.description: Where it hurts, when reason is pain.

name: swap_exercise
